purpose: Check whether translating a real question vector to analogous source evidence predicts the direction of the two grouping rules' retrieval differences before interpreting physical F1. This is a separate mechanism diagnostic on the 179 previously declared early/donor questions, not additional supervision.
fold: Exclude all queries and labels of the audited history from analogue candidates. For each unique (target session, benchmark question) with at least one focal evidence turn, predict the paired-minus-single reciprocal-rank difference from external queries. After actor freeze, condition the diagnostic on external analogues mapping at least one turn to the actual target annotations. Weight by overlap fraction times softmax source similarity at .08 within each external history; average the available histories equally. With zero analogues return zero and count abstention. Deduplicate repeated writer backgrounds and question IDs within target span.
comparison: For the measured target ranking use the actual held question only after the numeric policy freeze. Compare translated, unchanged donor query, target evidence centroid, and zero. Report MAE, sign matches on non-tied true differences (zero prediction does not match), coverage, per-history results and differences. Disclose that this audit conditions on evidence annotations; deployment uses none. Compare prediction with the no-change baseline even if improvements in ranking do not lead to improvements in physical F1. No diagnostic is used to tune the policy.
